name: com.zoran123456.lola-retro
description: A CRT shader that simulates the whole analog chain, not just scanlines: console video encoder, cable, TV decoder, electron beam, phosphor mask and glass. The Unity version of the RetroArch shader, with its TV and monitor presets. URP (Unity 6), HDRP and the Built-in render pipeline; SDR and HDR displays, XR and WebGL 2.

samples.description: A test picture through every preset: open the scene Lola Retro Demo and press Play. Built-in render pipeline and URP.
